extracted.name: Beef Tips and Noodles
extracted.description: This beef tips and noodles dish takes sirloin and mixes it with simple ingredients. Serve this easy, comforting recipe over noodles or with bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (1.25 ounce) package beef with onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Combine condensed soup, soup mix, mushrooms, and water in a 13x9-inch casserole dish. Mix thoroughly and add beef tips. Turn to coat well. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour.
While beef tips are cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.
Serve beef tips and sauce over noodles.
